name: Mama Love! ~Boku no Kanojo wa Boku no Mama ☆ Ottori Kyonyuu Aina-mama~
original_name: ママラブ！～僕の彼女は僕のママ☆おっとり巨乳愛奈ママ～
source:
The protagonist, Hayato, comes from a single-mother family. Having been lovingly raised by his mother, Aina, Hayato has come to love Aina not as a mother but as a woman.

But this mother is so cute that it's hard to believe she has a son!

After a series of events, Hayato comes to mistakenly believe that Aina is actually his father's second wife and is hiding the fact that they are not related by blood.

"Then surely it's fine if I confess?!"

With Hayato's confession, the story begins to move...

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc090/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
主人公隼人出身于单亲家庭。在母亲爱娜的悉心抚养下，隼人不再将爱娜视为母亲，而是将其视为女性。

但这位妈妈太可爱了，很难相信她有一个儿子！

经过一系列事件后，隼人误认为爱娜实际上是他父亲的第二任妻子，并隐瞒了他们没有血缘关系的事实。

“那我坦白就可以了吗？！”

随着隼人的告白，故事开始展开……

[翻译自[url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc090/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
